categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Fuxin Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the semiconductor thermoelectric industry, focusing on the research, design, manufacturing, and sales of semiconductor thermoelectric devices, thermoelectric systems, and thermoelectric complete machines. The company’s product portfolio includes semiconductor thermoelectric cooling devices, thermoelectric power generation devices, thermoelectric cooling systems, and integrated thermoelectric application products such as temperature-controlled wine cabinets, electronic refrigerators, beer machines, and temperature-controlled mattresses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced semiconductor thermoelectric technologies including Peltier effect-based cooling and power generation. It has proprietary material preparation technologies such as zone melting, powder hot pressing, and hot extrusion for bismuth telluride-based thermoelectric materials. Manufacturing innovations include automated device assembly, micro-device packaging, low-cold-loss sealing, and system integration technologies for efficient heat exchange and temperature control. The company also develops intelligent temperature control algorithms and patented technologies for humidity regulation and precise temperature maintenance in thermoelectric systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers span consumer electronics, communication, automotive, energy storage, and industrial sectors. Major clients include well-known brands such as SEB, Electrolux, Midea, Jura in consumer electronics; CATL, EVE Energy in energy storage; and leading optical module manufacturers in communications. The company serves both domestic and international markets, providing ODM and branded products, with a focus on high-growth areas like 5G optical modules, automotive thermal management, and energy storage cabinet dehumidification.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Foshan, Guangdong Province. It serves both domestic and international markets, with export sales accounting for a significant portion of revenue. The company actively expands its presence in global markets through ODM partnerships and strategic collaborations with international customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: Fuxin Technology operates across the semiconductor thermoelectric industry’s full value chain, from upstream material preparation and device manufacturing to midstream system integration and downstream complete machine applications. It controls core components production and system assembly, enabling comprehensive solutions and reducing reliance on external suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation in thermoelectric materials, device fabrication, system integration, and application development. It invests heavily in R&D, collaborating with top research institutes to develop high-performance materials and micro-scale devices meeting stringent reliability standards. Strategic R&D focuses include high-efficiency cooling systems for 400G/800G optical modules, automotive-grade thermoelectric devices, energy storage thermal management, and intelligent temperature and humidity control technologies. The company also emphasizes digital transformation and smart manufacturing to enhance production efficiency and product quality.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of semiconductor thermoelectric devices, systems, and integrated application products. The company employs both ODM and self-branded sales models, with domestic sales combining direct brand sales and ODM, while international sales mainly use ODM. Additional income sources include government subsidies, investment income, and interest from financial assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Fuxin Technology is a leading domestic player in the semiconductor thermoelectric industry, recognized for its full-industry-chain capabilities and advanced technology. It holds a strong market position in consumer electronics and is expanding rapidly in communication, automotive, and energy storage sectors. The company competes with both domestic and international thermoelectric technology providers but distinguishes itself through comprehensive R&D, quality management, and scale advantages. It is also a key contributor to the localization and high-end development of China's thermoelectric industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 515.6 million, a 29% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 44.48 million, reversing previous losses. Total assets reached about RMB 1 billion, with net assets of RMB 698.6 million. The company’s cash flow from operations nearly doubled compared to the prior year. R&D investment accounted for 6.55% of revenue, supporting sustained growth and innovation. The company maintains a stable shareholder base with total shares of 88.24 million.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Fuxin Technology emphasizes its proprietary semiconductor thermoelectric technologies that offer vibration-free, noiseless, environmentally friendly, and precise temperature control solutions. Its products feature high reliability, energy efficiency, and adaptability across diverse applications from consumer electronics to automotive and industrial sectors. The company’s full-industry-chain integration enables cost advantages, quality control, and rapid customization. Its patented innovations in materials, device assembly, and system integration provide competitive differentiation, enabling high-performance micro thermoelectric devices that meet stringent international standards.
